title: शब्दमञ्जरी — Vibhakti Tables from PDF Page 5 Onward
description: Vibhakti tables for each pratipadika, consolidated by word/model rather than by PDF page. Tables that span page breaks are kept continuous.

source_book.publisher: Samskrit Education Society (Regd.), 148-150 (98/99) Luz Church Road, Mylapore, Chennai-600004
source_book.editions_seen_in_scan: Cover shows 4th Edition 2005; a duplicated inner title page shows 3rd Edition 2003 (First: 1986, Second: 2001, Third: 2003) — the scan appears to interleave pages from two different print runs at the very front (pp.1-2); content pagination used below follows the PDF's own physical page order.

extraction_summary.continuity_handling: Each pratipadika is represented by one complete 8-row vibhakti table; page boundaries are not used as table boundaries. Where the source text gives alternate/optional forms for a case-number cell, both forms are joined with a hyphen in that single cell. Words 55 (वर्पाः) and 102 (अप्) occur only in the plural (nitya-bahuvachana); their singular and dual cells are marked '—'. Sections 7-13 (हलन्त / consonant-ending words) are complete: Section 7 words 71-96 (PDF pp.48-62); Section 8 words 97-110 (pp.62-69); Section 9 words 111-121 (pp.69-75); Section 10 (हलन्त पुंलिङ्ग विशेषशब्दाः) words 122-129 (pp.75-79); Section 11 (हलन्त विशेष शब्दाः) words 130-132 (pp.80-81); Section 12 (हलन्त स्त्रीलिङ्ग विशेष-शब्दाः) words 133-136 (pp.82-83); Section 13 (हलन्त नपुंसकलिङ्ग विशेष शब्दाः) words 137-143 (pp.84-88). Section 14 (सर्वनामशब्दाः, pronouns) begins at word 144 (PDF page 88); words 144-150 have been extracted so far and the section extends beyond word 150 (next word to extract: 151 यद् नपुंसकलिङ्ग, PDF page 91; the book's note on the missing vocative refers to pronoun words up to 180). The book prints no vocative row for pronouns (per its note for words 145-164 and 170-180; also absent for word 144); to keep the 8-row structure the संबोधनम् row of such tables is filled with '—' in every cell. In words 71-150, a final anusvara printed in the book (e.g. -शं, -शां, अहं, आवां) is normalised to final म् (e.g. -शम्, -शाम्, अहम्, आवाम्); internal anusvara (e.g. पुमांसौ, पुंसा, मनांसि, हवींषि, धनूंषि) is kept as printed. Vocative forms are kept as printed, including the prefix 'हे' where the book prints it (words 65, 125, 127). Where the book prints two lines for a case (words 130, 141), the two lines are joined with a hyphen in one cell; for 139 उदञ्च् the book's 'अथवा' alternate forms (उदक्, उदीची) are hyphen-joined with the main forms in the प्रथमा/द्वितीया/संबोधन rows. Stem-class label 'shakaranta' denotes श् (palatal) stems; retroflex ष् stems use 'shakaranta_retroflex' (words 91, 108, 130). Printer's errors corrected: word 128 गुप् vocative singular is printed 'गुपू' in the book and entered as गुप्; word 143 विद्वस् (neuter) vocative singular is printed 'विदुत्' and entered as विद्वत्. Forms entered exactly as printed even where unusual: 123 राट्त्सु-राट्सु; 141 असभ्याम्, असभिः, अससु. [Continued, words 151-180:] Section 14 (सर्वनामशब्दाः) is now complete through word 170 (source pp.88-101): relative pronouns 149-151 (यद्), demonstrative pronouns 152-157 (एतद्, इदम्), 158-160 (अदस्), interrogative pronouns 161-163 (किम्), and general pronouns 164-170 (सर्व, पूर्व, उभ, उभय). Words 164-169 have vocative rows printed (169 उभ has none, being dual-only); words 145-164 and 170-180 have no vocative per the book's own note on PDF p.87 ('संबोधनविभक्तिः नास्ति १४५-१६४, १७०-१८० पर्यन्तम्'), confirmed by word 180 (प्रथम) resuming a vocative row. Words 169 (उभ, dual-only) and 171-179 (numerals एक through कति, each fixed to one vachana) are single book-numbered entries covering all three genders in one table; for these, declension_table.headers is ['विभक्तिः','पुंलिङ्गे','स्त्रीलिङ्गे','नपुंसकलिङ्गे'] (gender columns) instead of the usual vachana columns, since the number (dual/singular/plural) is fixed rather than the gender. Word 170 (उभय, singular & plural only, 3 distinct genders) uses a 7-column headers ['विभक्तिः','पुं-एकवचनम्','पुं-बहुवचनम्','स्त्री-एकवचनम्','स्त्री-बहुवचनम्','नपुं-एकवचनम्','नपुं-बहुवचनम्'] to capture all 6 gender×vachana combinations without loss; its स्त्रीलिङ्ग चतुर्थी बहुवचनम् is printed 'उभयीभिः' (identical to तृतीया), apparently a printer's duplication (expected उभयीभ्यः), entered exactly as printed. Words 175-179 (पञ्चन्, षष्, सप्तन्, अष्टन्, कति) are identical across all three genders, so their tables use a single value column ['विभक्तिः','रूपम् (त्रिषु लिङ्गेषु समानम्)']. Word 178 (अष्टन्) prints two alternate paradigms (अष्ट-pattern and अष्टौ/अष्टा-pattern), hyphen-joined per the existing alternate-form convention.
